rows.question: How many students are there?

sql.answer: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students

base.answer: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students;

rows.question: List the names of students majoring in Computer Science.

sql.answer: SELECT name FROM students WHERE major = 'Computer Science'

base.answer: SELECT name FROM students WHERE major = 'Computer Science';

rows.question: What is the average GPA for each major?

sql.answer: SELECT AVG(gpa), major FROM students GROUP BY major

base.answer: SELECT major, AVG(gpa) FROM students GROUP BY major;

rows.question: Which student has the highest GPA? Return their name.

sql.answer: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1

base.answer: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1;

rows.question: How many students are enrolled in each course? Return the course title and the count.

sql.answer: SELECT T1.title, COUNT(*) FROM courses AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.id

base.answer: SELECT T1.title, COUNT(T2.student_id) FROM courses AS T1 LEFT JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.id

rows.question: List the names of students who are not enrolled in any course.

sql.answer: SELECT name FROM students WHERE NOT major = ANY(major) AND NOT gpa = ANY(grade) AND NOT year = ANY(year)

base.answer: SELECT name FROM students WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments)

rows.question: What is the total number of credits each enrolled student is taking? Return the student name and total credits.

sql.answer: SELECT T1.name, T1.credits FROM students AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.student_id JOIN courses AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.id WHERE T3.title = 'Math' INTERSECT SELECT T1.name, T1.credits FROM students AS T1 JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.student_id JOIN courses AS T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.id WHERE T3.dept = 'Math'

base.answer: SELECT T1.name, SUM(T2.credits) FROM students AS T1 INNER JOIN enrollments AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.name

rows.question: Find the names of students whose GPA is above the average GPA of all students.

sql.answer: SELECT name FROM students WHERE gpa > (SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students)

base.answer: SELECT name FROM students WHERE gpa > (SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students)

rows.question: List the titles of Mathematics department courses worth more than 3 credits.

sql.answer: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE dept = 'Mathematics' AND credits > 3

base.answer: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE credits > 3 AND dept = 'Mathematics'

rows.question: How many distinct majors are there?

sql.answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT major) FROM students

base.answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT major) FROM students;

rows.question: How many students are in year 1?

sql.answer: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE gpa > 3.5 AND year = 1

base.answer: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE year = 1;

rows.question: What is the lowest GPA among Biology majors?

sql.answer: SELECT MIN(gpa) FROM students WHERE major = "Biology" AND year = "Senior"

base.answer: SELECT MIN(gpa) FROM students WHERE major = 'Biology';

rows.question: List the names of students with a GPA between 3.0 and 3.6.

sql.answer: SELECT name FROM students WHERE gpa BETWEEN 3.0 AND 3.6

base.answer: SELECT name FROM students WHERE gpa BETWEEN 3.0 AND 3.6;

rows.question: Which majors have more than one student?

sql.answer: SELECT major FROM students GROUP BY major HAVING COUNT(name) > 1

base.answer: SELECT major FROM students GROUP BY major HAVING COUNT(id) > 1;

rows.question: What is the average GPA of students in year 3 or higher?

sql.answer: SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students WHERE major = 'Math' AND year >= 3

base.answer: SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students WHERE year >= 3;

rows.question: List the names of the three students with the lowest GPA.

sql.answer: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY gpa LIMIT 3

base.answer: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY gpa LIMIT 3;

rows.question: How many students are there in each year?

sql.answer: SELECT COUNT(*), year FROM students GROUP BY year

base.answer: SELECT COUNT(*) ,  year FROM students GROUP BY year;

rows.question: What is the name of the Economics major with the highest GPA?

sql.answer: SELECT name FROM students WHERE major = "Economics" ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1

base.answer: SELECT name FROM students WHERE major = 'Economics' ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What is the total number of credits offered by the Mathematics department?

sql.answer: SELECT SUM(credits) FROM courses WHERE dept = 'Mathematics'

base.answer: SELECT SUM(credits) FROM courses WHERE dept = 'Mathematics';

rows.question: List the course titles that have exactly 4 credits.

sql.answer: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE credits = 4

base.answer: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE credits = 4;

rows.question: Which department offers the most courses?

sql.answer: SELECT dept, COUNT(*) FROM courses GROUP BY dept ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

base.answer: SELECT dept FROM courses GROUP BY dept ORDER BY COUNT(id) DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What is the average number of credits per course in each department?

sql.answer: SELECT AVG(credits), dept FROM courses GROUP BY dept

base.answer: SELECT AVG(credits) FROM courses GROUP BY dept

rows.question: What is the highest grade recorded in course 3?

sql.answer: SELECT MAX(grade) FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = 3

base.answer: SELECT MAX(grade) FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = 3;

rows.question: How many enrollments have a grade below 3.2?

sql.answer: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE grade < 3.2

base.answer: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE grade < 3.2;

rows.question: Which student IDs are enrolled in more than one course?

sql.answer: SELECT student_id FROM enrollments GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) > 1

base.answer: SELECT student_id FROM enrollments GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(course_id) > 1;
